name: @inwell/shared
description: Types shared between apps/api and apps/web that used to be hand-duplicated in three places (see the code review, section 5). apps/web (Vite) and apps/api's dev mode (tsx) can both load .ts source directly, but apps/api's production image runs plain `node dist/index.js` with no TS loader, so this package needs a real build step -- 'main'/'exports' point at compiled dist/, built via the 'build' script (see both Dockerfiles and the root 'postinstall' script, which builds it automatically after `npm install`).
